summary.en: Hong Kong's triathlon mixed relay quartet of Cade Wright, Bailee Brown, Oscar Coggins and Robin Elg won bronze on Monday. The podium finish continues the city's remarkable consistency in the event, marking a third consecutive Asian Games medal in the mixed relay.

summary.en: Hong Kong's women's 4x100m freestyle relay team claimed a surprise silver on the opening night of the Asian Games swimming programme. Siobhan Haughey, Natalie Kan Cheuk-tung and Li Sum-yiu swam the final, with Gilaine Ma and Wang Xintong contributing in the heats, as the squad smashed the Hong Kong record. The medal was the city's second of the Games, arriving on the same historic evening as Grace Lau's karate silver.

summary.en: Hong Kong U23 stunned Thailand with 胡晉銘's 13th-minute opener in their Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games group match on September 20. The lead lasted only until half-time before Thailand scored four times after the break to complete a 5-1 rout. It was Hong Kong's second straight defeat after an opening 0-2 loss to Japan, leaving their knockout hopes all but over.

summary.en: Brighton thrashed champions Arsenal 3-0 at the Amex on Sept 19, with goals from Georginio Rutter, Diego Gomez and Maxim De Cuyper. The Seagulls moved level on 10 points with Arsenal, sitting third on goal difference. It was a miserable 350th game in charge for Mikel Arteta as Brighton delivered a masterclass.
